ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (Howling Scorpius / PUNK SPIDER) shadow-copy wipe + akira_readme.txt drop chain
ucs.description: Detects Akira's signature pre-encryption sequence — PowerShell/WMIC deletion of Volume Shadow Copies (the operator-favored `Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject` one-liner) immediately followed by the actor's hard-coded ransom-note filename or extension drop (`akira_readme.txt`, `.akira`, `.powerranges`, `.akiranew`). Both halves are documented in CISA AA24-109A and Sophos/Mandiant reporting on Akira/Megazord.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as vssTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-WmiObject*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*") by host Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as fileTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="akira_readme.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.akira" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.powerranges" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.akiranew") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` ] | where fileTime>=vssTime AND fileTime<=relative_time(vssTime,"+2h") | convert ctime(vssTime) ctime(fileTime) | table vssTime fileTime host user process file_path file_name parent_process_name
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let VssDelete = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project VssTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              VssCmd = ProcessCommandLine, VssParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RansomArtifact = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "akira_readme.txt"
         or FileName endswith ".akira"
         or FileName endswith ".powerranges"
         or FileName endswith ".akiranew"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RansomFile = FileName,
              RansomPath = FolderPath, RansomWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName;
VssDelete
| join kind=inner RansomArtifact on DeviceId
| where FileTime between (VssTime .. VssTime + 2h)   // 2h = empirical VSS-wipe -> encryption gap seen in Akira IR
| project VssTime, FileTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FileTime, VssTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, VssCmd, VssParent,
          RansomFile, RansomPath, RansomWriter
| order by VssTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let VssDelete = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","delete shadows","shadowcopy delete")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project VssTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, VssCmd = CommandLine, VssParent = ParentProcessName;
let RansomArtifact = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName =~ "akira_readme.txt"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".akira"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".powerranges"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".akiranew"
    | project FileTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, RansomFile = TargetFileName,
              RansomPath = TargetFilePath, RansomWriter = ActingProcessName;
VssDelete
| join kind=inner RansomArtifact on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where FileTime between (VssTime .. VssTime + 2h)   // 2h = empirical wipe->encryption gap
| project VssTime, FileTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FileTime, VssTime),
          Computer, SubjectUserName, VssCmd, VssParent,
          RansomFile, RansomPath, RansomWriter
| order by VssTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe) @CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *Win32_ShadowCopy* OR *Remove-WmiObject* OR *"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wmic|vssadmin)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(Win32_Shadowcopy|Remove-WmiObject|delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete)/i
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/(akira_readme\.txt$|\.akira$|\.powerranges$|\.akiranew$)/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The (a) WMI/PowerShell shadow-copy wipe and (b) `akira_readme.txt` / `.akira` / `.powerranges` / `.akiranew` artifact are both actor-specific fingerprints — not generic ransomware traits. Other crews use vssadmin or wmic, but Akira operators have repeatedly chosen the WMI-cmdlet variant (Get-WmiObject ... | Remove-WmiObject) documented by Arctic Wolf, Sophos and CISA AA24-109A, and the readme file

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira double-extortion exfil staging — Rclone to MEGA or password-protected multi-volume WinRAR archive
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's pre-encryption data-theft phase: either `rclone.exe` copy/sync to a MEGA remote (Akira's documented exfil sink), or a `WinRAR/rar.exe/7z.exe` invocation with password (`-hp`) and multi-volume split (`-v<N>m/g`) used to stage NTLM-relay'd file-share content prior to upload. Both behaviours are called out in the CISA #StopRansomware Akira advisory and Mandiant/Sophos Akira IR notes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*--ignore-existing*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("rar.exe","winrar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe") AND Processes.process="*-hp*" AND Processes.process="*-v*") ) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RcloneMega = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:", "mega.nz")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--multi-thread-streams","--ignore-existing","--transfers");
let RarSplit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("rar.exe","winrar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "-hp"        // password-protect — Akira operator default
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-v\d+[mg]"   // multi-volume split (e.g. -v500m)
;
union RcloneMega, RarSplit
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RcloneMega = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz")
         or CommandLine has_any ("--multi-thread-streams","--ignore-existing","--transfers");
let RarSplit = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\rar.exe","\\winrar.exe","\\7z.exe","\\7za.exe")
    | where CommandLine has "-hp"
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-v\d+[mg]";
union RcloneMega, RarSplit
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira ransomware double-extortion exfil staging (rclone-to-MEGA or password-protected multi-volume RAR/7z)
id: 7a3a8d12-c8b1-4e9f-9c2a-akira-exfilstage
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects Akira ransomware operators staging data before encryption — either rclone copy/sync to a MEGA remote, or rar/7z compression with password (-hp) AND multi-volume split (-v<N>m/g). Both patterns are documented in CISA AA24-109A and Sophos/Mandiant Akira IR reporting.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2023/05/09/akira-ransomware-is-bringin-1988-back/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1560.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  rclone_image:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  rclone_mega:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'mega.nz'
  archive_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rar.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\7za.exe'
  archive_password:
    CommandLine|contains: '-hp'
  archive_split:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)-v\d+[mg]'
  condition: (rclone_image and rclone_mega) or (archive_image and archive_password and archive_split)
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup or cloud-migration tooling using rclone with mega: remote (rare — verify with IT)
  - Sysadmin one-offs creating password-protected multi-volume archives (verify user / parent process)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *mega.nz* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *--ignore-existing*)) OR (@Image:(*\\rar.exe OR *\\RAR.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7Z.exe OR *\\7za.exe) AND @CommandLine:*\-hp* AND @CommandLine:(*\-v100m* OR *\-v500m* OR *\-v1g* OR *\-v5g* OR *\-v10g*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(mega:|mega\.nz|--multi-thread-streams|--ignore-existing|--transfers\s+\d+)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(rar|winrar|7z|7za)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/-hp\S*/ AND CommandLine=/-v\d+[mg]/i)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Rclone-to-MEGA is the documented Akira exfil sink (CISA AA24-109A, Sophos X-Ops, Arctic Wolf TRU). The combination of `rclone.exe` + `mega:` remote, OR rar/7z with `-hp` (password) + `-v<N>m/g` (multi-volume split for staging through size-limited upload pipes) is the precise tooling Akira affiliates have used repeatedly — not random crypto-locker tradecraft. Excluding machine accounts and pairing
